Tofflo for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax

Tofflo is on HMRC's list of software recognised for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax. HMRC lists it as software that creates digital records, for UK property income. It can send your quarterly updates and submit your tax return.

  • It is built for landlords: HMRC lists property as its only income type.

What it can put on your tax return

HMRC lists 0 of 16 other income and tax-return items as ready now, 5 in development and 11 not included. "In development" means the provider has told HMRC it will build it in time for the 2026 to 2027 tax return.

Other details

Update periods: standard (6 April to 5 April) Yes; calendar (1 April to 31 March) Yes. For individuals: Yes. For agents: No. Accessibility features listed: Blindness or impaired vision, Deafness or impaired hearing, Motor or physical difficulties, Cognitive impairments. Language: English.

Getting started

  1. Check you need MTD and when: our plain-English guide.
  2. Sign up for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax on GOV.UK, if you haven't already.
  3. Choose your software, then authorise it with HMRC.
